info.title: Sports2000 Orders API - media type versioning
info.description: One URI, the media type selects the version. Accept selects the version of the response, Content-Type the version of the request body. application/vnd.sports2000.order.v2+json (or application/json, a wildcard or no Accept header) is the current version. application/vnd.sports2000.order.v1+json is DEPRECATED (schemas marked deprecated; responses carry Deprecation, Sunset and Link headers). application/vnd.sports2000.order.v0+json has been switched off (410). Every response carries Vary: Accept.
